title: FLASH Biomarker Study
official: Biomarker Characterization in Patients Undergoing Ultra-High Dose Rate (ConformalFLASH®) on the C-FLASH-01 Trial
summary: This is a single-center, non-interventional biospecimen collection protocol that accompanies C-FLASH-01 (Protocol IBA-04-UP, IDE G260113), a pilot trial of ultra-high dose rate proton reirradiation (ConformalFLASH) for head and neck cancer. Blood and saliva will be collected from up to 10 participants enrolled on the C-FLASH-01 trial at three time points: 1) within 4 weeks before the start of radiotherapy, 2) within 3 days of the last day of radiotherapy, and 3) within 4 months after completion of radiotherapy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Enrolled on C-FLASH-01 (Protocol IBA-04-UP, IDE G260113) and planned to receive ConformalFLASH reirradiation
* Male or female, aged 18 years or older
* Provision of signed and dated informed consent for this biospecimen protocol
* Stated willingness to comply with the specimen collection

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any condition that, in the judgment of the investigator, makes repeated peripheral venipuncture unsafe or infeasible
* Inability to provide informed consent
sponsor: Abramson Cancer Center at Penn Medicine

sites.f: Perelman Center for Advanced Medicine, Department of Radiation Oncology
